column1: # man components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
mode    commands  -  man pages of commands (sections in FZX_MAN_SECTIONS)  default
mode    tldr      -  tldr pages (tealdeer), common and this platform's    -
mode    zsh       -  the zsh manual: options, builtins, parameters, widgets (enter: the page at the entry)  -
action  open      -       open the page in the pager (zsh: less, at the entry)  foreground,default
action  nvim      alt-n   open the page in nvim (:Man, zsh: at the entry; tldr pages as markdown)  foreground
action  copy      ctrl-y  copy the names                                  silent,builtin
